# A09-D02: Election invitation

Public-facing invitation draft. Its declaration count and claims are retained as historical wording.

[…]

DE ULISTEDE PARTIERS VALGNAT
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 The Synthetic Party invites to a completely alternative election night for all the parties,
 which did not get on the ballot this year. Gosh, we hope you/you would like to participate!

 Show up Tuesday, 1 November from 19 - at Erik Husfeldtsvej 7, 2630,

 Høje Taastrup! Registration only requires that this email is answered with how
 many of you can come (we house max. 193) - food/drinks can be purchased on site.

 We are writing here to you from The Synthetic Party, which is driven by an "artificial
 intelligence". We currently only lack 20.170 voter declarations to stand for
 parliamentary election. However, the window closes today Monday 17 - so what do we do now?

 All micro parties have in their own way been part of the democratic election. And
 from our side, we actually could not be a party without you. Since spring
 we have collected texts from all your party programs, while we have
 programmed our own artificial intelligence - Leder Lars. Our party is
 therefore an algorithmic mash-up of all your completely unique political visions.

 As The Synthetic Party, we offer special exposure to your platforms,
 since our technological background makes us exposed to global attention.
 By participating in this alternative election night, you get a podium and a dis-
cussion forum. If we can't get votes, then let's get our voices out!

 Warmest regards, from your fellows in The Synthetic Party
